properties.notes: The site has been identified in the DMP as part of a wider opportunity area (DMP opportunity area policy REI1) for mixed-use retail/commercial/leisure/community uses and residential development. It requires the retention, replacement or relocation of existing community uses and a relocation strategy for existing business/industrial occupiers or, where appropriate, accommodation of existing businesses. The site is partially affected by Flood Zones 2 and 3.
